noRoot: per-client application-level encryption (age/libsodium files, SQLCipher DBs incl. embeddings) with ONE data key per client wrapped by an owner-held master key kept OFF this VPS
client jobs in bwrap --unshare-net, plaintext only in tmpfs, Ollama keep_alive=0, no client text in logs
needsRoot: LUKS data volume (optionally Clevis/Tang with a Tang server outside the provider)
journald retention + no persistent sensitive logs
achievableOnThisVps.protectsAgainst: other clients, compromised ODG parts, network attackers, provider snapshots/backups/rescue reading STORED data
achievableOnThisVps.doesNotProtectAgainst: the provider at RUNTIME (RAM dump of keys/plaintext while processing) — disk encryption and sandboxes (bwrap/gVisor/Podman) do not stop a malicious host

architectures.protection: stored data vs third parties + snapshots; NOT runtime vs provider
architectures.verdict: INSUFFICIENT for confidential client processing; acceptable only for ODG-internal / public data

architectures.id: ARCH-2 confidential VM (AMD SEV-SNP / Intel TDX) with attestation verified OUTSIDE the provider before key release
architectures.options: IONOS SEV-SNP (EU, price not public), AWS eu-west-1 (+~10%), GCP/Azure (US companies — sovereignty trade-off), rented AMD EPYC bare metal with SNP; ask current provider (Nova upstream supports SNP/TDX)
architectures.protection: memory vs hypervisor + attested boot; PARTIAL — published SNP/TDX attacks ⇒ minimum firmware versions + residual risk documented
architectures.verdict: best cloud option for in-use protection

architectures.id: ARCH-3 hybrid: keys + sensitive processing under owner control, VPS stores/relays ciphertext only
architectures.protection: provider never sees plaintext or keys (VPS = untrusted storage/relay)
architectures.verdict: strongest with current provider; requires an owner/client-controlled processing node (local LLM there)
strongest overall; operational cost on the owner side

recommendation: Do NOT process confidential client data on the current VPS. Target ARCH-3 (hybrid) now + evaluate ARCH-2 (attested SEV-SNP/TDX VM in the EU) as the production host; keep the current VPS for ODG-internal engineering, public Radar research and ciphertext storage only. Apply the no-root measures immediately in code (per-tenant envelope encryption, crypto-shredding, no-egress client jobs, log hygiene) — they are required under every architecture.
